items.title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million estate faces opposition over landscaping plans
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh delays as neighbors challenge his landscaping and fencing plans. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, lake views and potential damage to an aging sewer line, with one neighbor citing $75,000 in repair costs. Kelce’s construction team says it has spent $7,500 on sewer repairs and adjusted the plans. However, local officials require further changes before the remaining landscaping work can proceed.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany's KC Current extend unbeaten home run to 31 games
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ Kansas City Current have secured their third consecutive NWSL playoff berth after Portland’s 1-0 win over North Carolina. The club now aims to secure home-field advantage ahead of the postseason. Despite roster changes, Kansas City has maintained a record 31-game unbeaten home streak. Temwa Chawinga leads the team with 12 goals, while Croix Bethune has recorded 10 assists heading into the decisive final matches.
